notes: [toolclean-01 (OWNER queue 10-03: craftsync -> craftroom -> composter -> SPENT-TOOL CLEANUP -> chest fix -> bamboo -> logpickup). Variant for fleet 56db2cd (composter-01 KEPT+promoted), branch tc-on-56db2cd @ 1918bb5. Launched by chain-after.sh when composter-01 ends; STOPs if the fleet is not 56db2cd.] SPENT TOOLS FILL BAGS: full bags (59/80 at >= 34 slots) held 191 spent dig-tool copies; ~118-170 at 2-10 uses, mostly SOLE axes (74) and shovels (53) that toolFor's 10-use reserve never released (no block needs an axe/shovel, so the hand won). THE CHANGE (designed by both engines from that data; both engines AGREE after two rounds + the rebuild): no reserve for axes/shovels/hoes; the most-worn same-name copy first; a 1-use axe/shovel/hoe is swung on HARVEST digs and breaks (drop lands); travel/reflex digs keep a 1-use hard stop; a spent axe/shovel/hoe beats the hand when strictly faster; on stone-family harvest digs a 1-use pickaxe is swung only while another pickaxe with > 10 uses is held. PAPER SANDBOX (6 scenes x 3 reps x 2 arms): candidate wore spent tools first in every scene, 20 of 21 broken-tool drops reached the bag (the miss also happens on control); control never touched a spent tool. KNOWN (pre-existing, both arms): a pathfinder travel dig can swing a held 1-use shovel when travelTool finds nothing else to hand back (1 of 13).

licence.note: New kind written only by this build (harvest swing of a spent tool).

require.name: gather activity (harvest digs are where spent tools get swung)

exposure.note: Ready = >= 5 canary axe/shovel/hoe spent swings AND control _last_swing + pickaxe _tool_broke >= 1 (87 in the dry run 10-04).

own_lines.note: G1: a spend_spent swing whose own snapshot shows no other pickaxe with > 10 uses.
G2: pickaxes with > 10 uses go from >= 1 to 0 within 10 s after a spend_spent swing.
G3: a tool with > 10 uses left gone outside a death or deposit (+-5 s).
POSITIVE CONTROL: the tool rows are visible to this query. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: spent (<= 10 uses) axe/shovel/hoe copies per bot DiD; 1-use pickaxes per bot DiD; equip-fallback failures.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.

amendments.change: deposit association window from |t_tool_gone - t_deposit| <= 5 s to t_deposit - 5 s <= t_tool_gone <= t_deposit + deposit.duration_ms + 5 s
amendments.why: deposit rows are stamped at START and deposits run 0.3-24 s; at +85 min G3 read 2 canary breaches (hive-c-Comet 19 s after a 18.9 s deposit of 127 items, hive-c-Delta 15 s after a 15.0 s deposit). ALL 10 good-tool _tool_gone rows in the window (pre+post, canary+control: canary 1 pre/2 post, control 4 pre/3 post) sit inside the amended window; none is explained by toolclean. Spare usable pickaxes are bankable (bankable.mjs), so a deposit removing one is intended. Threshold unchanged (<= 0, REVERT).
